title: 24 GB Mac 零 Swap 并发 160 个 AI 浏览器：干掉 Node MCP 后连 Chrome 自身也省了 503 MB
content: Sessfork achieves 160 concurrent AI agents on a 24 GB MacBook without swapping by integrating a Rust-based CDP adapter with the Moli browser. This configuration reduces per-agent memory usage to 93.4 MB, significantly outperforming Node.js-based Playwright MCP setups. The approach eliminates JavaScript injection into Chrome’s V8 heap, lowering overall memory consumption by over 500 MB. Benchmarks confirm stable performance with high throughput, zero resource exhaustion, and robust security validation, establishing a scalable, low-overhead solution for local AI browser automation.

title: 大一统最后一块拼图，GPT-6 Astra啃了4亿token
content: OpenAI researcher Venkatesa Chandrasekaran published a preprint proposing a quantization of pure four-dimensional vacuum gravity. Collaborating with GPT-6 Astra, he calculated finite gravitational amplitudes and derived the black hole entropy coefficient 106/45. This result matches a 2013 calculation by Ashoke Sen. The paper, which awaits peer review, does not yet incorporate matter or unify gravity with other forces.

content: Published in The Lancet, the Natsal survey reports a significant decline in sexual activity among younger Britons, with frequency halving to an average of two encounters per month. Approximately one-third of this demographic has never had sexual intercourse. The study, part of the UK’s National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles, provides long-term comparative data essential for evaluating reproductive health trends and designing effective public health interventions.
